# Recursive Task Decomposition

Enables recursive decomposition to break complex problems into manageable subtasks.

## Usage
- Recursively decomposes large tasks into smaller, solvable units
- Builds a task tree with dependency tracking between subtasks
- Solves leaf tasks first and merges results bottom-up
- Configurable recursion depth limit to prevent runaway decomposition
